content: {"episode_id":"ep-05125","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93247, long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring, for this patient who presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope (R55) in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). As the clinical indication note states, the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances make long-term continuous ECG monitoring indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of collapse. Because the documented indication directly supports CPT 93247, we request reconsideration of the determination that this service is not covered under the member's benefit plan."}
